newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's tourist, Suez Canal revenue fall in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's tourist, Suez Canal revenue fall in Oct.

text.p: Egypt's tourist receipts declined sharply to $273.3 million in October from their 40-month peak of $428.5 million in September, the cabinet's statistics bureau said in a report obtained by Reuters on Thursday.
In October, 1995, revenue from tourism was $284 million.
Suez Canal revenues continued their downward trend to $1.533 billion in the first 11 months of 1996 from $1.619 billion in the same period last year, the report said.
The canal's income in October, however, rose to $154.3 million from $148.1 million in September. It was $164.3 million in October, 1995, the report added.
The number of ships transiting the strategic waterway was marginally up in October at 1,244 from 1,181 in September but down from 1,271 in the same month last year.
